articles.title: Jemima Goldsmith accuses Russell Brand of violence and abuse against her
articles.description: Goldsmith accuses the disgraced entertainer of "violence, coercive control and abuse" while they were in a relationship.

articles.title: What happened inside court as Brand was sentenced
articles.description: The BBC's Sima Kotecha was inside the court as the judge sentenced Brand to 10 years and six months in prison, after being convicted of rape and sexual assault.

articles.title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England
articles.description: The government says it is strengthening its guidance for schools in England, which came into force in June.

articles.title: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'
articles.description: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation change.
